mapper.select: SELECT * FROM lm_stability_scheme_item WHERE version_id = #{versionId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT si.id, si.scheme_id AS schemeId, si.version_id AS versionId, si.inspect_item_id AS inspectItemId, si.duration, si.time_unit AS timeUnit, ii.name AS inspectItemName, ii.code AS inspectItemCode FROM lm_stability_scheme_item si LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_item ii ON si.inspect_item_id = ii.id AND ii.is_deleted = 0 WHERE si.version_id = #{versionId} AND si.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY si.id ASC
